statement.text: No vaccine or treatment is licensed for Bundibugyo virus.
statement.quote: Bundibugyo virus remains one of the least studied Orthoebolaviruses with no licensed vaccine or treatment.

products.name: Tumaini vaccine trial
products.developer: CEPI, INRB, University of Antwerp, DRC Ministry of Health, WHO and partners
products.note: A Phase 2/3 trial that tests several candidate vaccines in one study, by vaccinating contacts of cases in DR Congo.

events.text: Phase 2/3 trial registered for 3,620 participants in DR Congo.
CEPI says the first participant was vaccinated.

quotes: First participant vaccinated in pivotal Phase 2/3 Bundibugyo vaccine trial in DRC

products.name: Ervebo
products.note: Licensed against a different Ebola species (Zaire). Whether it protects against Bundibugyo virus is not established; that is what the studies below measure.

events.text: Authorised in the EU against Zaire ebolavirus.
Phase 4 study of Ervebo in about 20,000 frontline workers in DR Congo during this outbreak.

products.name: mRNA-1469
products.note: Candidate vaccine designed for Bundibugyo virus.

events.text: Phase 1 study in African participants in Uganda, 224 participants.

products.name: ChAdOx1 BDBV
products.developer: University of Oxford, with Serum Institute of India
products.note: Candidate vaccine designed for Bundibugyo virus.

events.text: CEPI says a Phase 1 trial has launched in Oxford.

products.name: PARTNERS treatment trial
products.developer: WHO (sponsor), with research partners in DR Congo, Belgium and the UK
products.note: A randomised trial of candidate treatments for people with Bundibugyo virus disease.

events.text: WHO says patient enrolment has begun.
